deviations_from_bluemicro840: Second regulator (switched 3.3 V for external devices, P0.12 enable) omitted: nothing external to power.
USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array added on D+ / D- / VBUS at the USB-C receptacle.
Power switch SW101 (C&K JS102011SAQN, 300 mA) in the battery + line, as on ZMK keyboards; JP2 bypasses it.
JP1 + R104: closing the solder jumper puts a second 10k on PROG: charge current 100 mA -> 200 mA.
Reset push button SW102 to GND (the BlueMicro840 has only a test point).
USB-C shield pads to GND (left open on the BlueMicro840).
LEDs: charging LED white, status LED red on P1.04 only (BlueMicro840: green charging, red P1.04, blue P1.10).
DCCH inductor pads (DNP on the BlueMicro840) not fitted at all; P1.10 is a free GPIO here, P1.02 switches the sound card.
Test points added on VBUS, VBAT and VIN (BlueMicro840: SWDIO, SWCLK, VCC, GND, RESET, P1.02).
C107 4.7 uF added on VBUS at the charger's VDD pin (the MCP73831 datasheet asks for 4.7 uF; Nordic's reference circuit has 4.7 uF on VBUS; the BlueMicro840 has none).

C108 1 uF at the regulator output and C109 100 nF at the module: the 4.7 uF C103 sits at the module's supply pins (VDD / VDDH), 25 mm away (the module has about 12 uF inside: the TPS7A02 allows 1-22 uF on its output). C102 on VIN is 1 uF instead of 10 uF: together they keep the capacitance charged at USB attach near USB 2.0's 10 uF.

Charger MCP73831 instead of the TP4054, same pins and same PROG resistor (1000 V / R_PROG): it is stable with no battery, so the board also works when built without one (its STAT pin, and the white LED, stay off).

Battery divider 10M + 10M with 10 nF (BlueMicro840: 806k + 2M, 1 nF): the MCP73831 recognises a missing battery only if VBAT sees more than 7 MOhm (datasheet 4.2); 10 nF >= 2^12 x the SAADC's 2.5 pF keeps the reading within 1 LSB (Nordic, 'Measuring Lithium battery voltage with nRF52'), and RMK samples it every 30 s. Drain 0.2 uA.

Built-in USB sound card: the USB-C data lines go (through the ESD array) to a CH334P hub; hub port 3 goes to the module's D+ / D-, port 2 to a CM108B codec (C-Media demo board v1.33) with a 3.5 mm headset jack.

Reverse-battery P-MOSFET Q2 (SI2301) between the battery connector and the switch, gate to GND: a cell plugged in the wrong way round finds it off (its body diode blocks), so the charger's VBAT pin never sees a negative voltage; the right way round it is on (Vgs = -Vbat) and charging goes through it.
Regulator TPS7A0233 (25 nA quiescent, 200 mA) instead of the AP2112K (55 uA): same SOT-23-5 pins (IN, GND, EN, NC, OUT); the 3.3 V rail needs < 50 mA (module, status LED).

VBUS: an SMF5.0A TVS at the receptacle, and C107 (4.7 uF) through 1 ohm: a ceramic-only VBUS rings on hot plug to 6-8 V through the cable's inductance (simulated, 0.5-1 uH); damped, 5.0-6.6 V, without adding capacitance.
